MemAvailable is therefore understated by about 24.7 GiB again, and Claude Code's background-shell memory guard can kill lane jobs again. The lane gates still use MemFree + Inactive(file). A lasting value of 10 requires a change to the NixOS configuration, not sysctl -w.
